## What and why / 改了什么，为什么



## Checklist / 自查

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass / `npm test` 和 `npm run build` 都通过
- [ ] Stays a local, read-only reader: no backend, no uploads, no runtime third-party scripts / 仍是本地只读的阅读器：没有后端、不上传、运行时不加载第三方脚本
- [ ] Interface text is updated in both languages in `src/core/i18n.ts` / 界面文字在 `src/core/i18n.ts` 里中英两份都改了
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` are updated together, if needed / 需要时两份 README 一起改了
- [ ] A line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, for a change users can see / 用户看得到的变化，在 `CHANGELOG.md` 的 `Unreleased` 下加了一条
